svg.aria-label: GreenBranch's original deployment on AWS EC2. A push to main built a Docker image for server-ai or for the server-ec2 agent, pushed it to Docker Hub, then SSHed into that service's EC2 instance to pull it and replace the running container. The frontend on Vercel called server-ai on port 8000 for runs and the WebSocket, and the agent on port 8001 to clone repositories. The agent container mounted the Docker socket and ran install and test commands with docker exec in long-running python and node executor containers that shared /home/ubuntu/repos. Sessions lived in a Redis reached by URL, and server-ai called Groq.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

What each deploy ran over SSH
No tests ran before the build, and nothing checked the new container after it started.
